notes: The catalog text (page 61) contains only the Administration of Justice A.S. CTE Degree (AS.ADJ). No Certificate of Achievement section is in the text, so no requirements, outcomes or careers were recorded for the certificate. A reviewer should locate the certificate's own page in the catalog PDF.

In the A.S. section, the Required Major Courses (ADJ1, ADJ2, ADJ3, ADJ4, ADJ5, ADJ11, ADJ21A) match the closed list exactly. The certificate may consist of these courses, but the text does not state it.
The A.S. section lists Major Electives: complete at least 3 courses from ADJ8, ADJ10, ADJ25, ADJ30, ADJ33, ADJ34, ADJ36, ADJ51 and ADJ102. It also requires Local GE. It prints no unit totals.

The A.S. section prints seven program outcomes and names employment in criminal justice and paralegal/legal assistantship. These were not recorded because they are printed for the degree, not the certificate.
The A.S. catalog description also contains AS-T (transfer degree) wording, which appears to be mixed in from another program.
